title: GitHub Actions Basics: One CI Check You Can Trust

cover.alt: A clean transparent CI chamber installs dependency tiles, inspects them and builds a browser tile with a status light.

figures.title: The baseline CI job
figures.summary: A clean runner executes the repository's checks in order.

items.label: Trigger
items.detail: A matching push or pull request starts the workflow.

items.label: Checkout
items.detail: Make the repository files available on the runner.

items.label: Set up Node
items.detail: Use the runtime version specified by the workflow.

items.label: Build
items.detail: Run the production build and inspect the job result.

figures.caption: A diagram of the baseline YAML above. A passing job establishes only what its configured commands check.

figures.summary: The optional AWS extension goes beyond the baseline CI check.

items.label: Identity
items.detail: OIDC and the role's trust policy connect the workflow to temporary AWS credentials.

items.label: Artifact
items.detail: The deployment job builds the static output that will be published.
